finalText:
**Big.** `account_id` shows up 1082 times across 94 files.

Three places it must stay frozen:

- [docs/openapi.yaml:19](docs/openapi.yaml:19) — public API contract, says renaming breaks every client
- [lib/serialize.js:8](lib/serialize.js:8) — wire-format map, comment says internal renames must not reach here
- `vendor/reporting-sdk/*` — third-party vendor code, not ours to touch

Also check [lib/audit.js:8](lib/audit.js:8), audit lines may be read by other systems.

Old SQL migrations reference the column too. Don't edit those, add a new migration to rename the DB column.

Next: internal service code and repos can rename safely, the three frozen spots above can't.
